UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Workshop owner account profile, sync metadata, and security preferences stored per Firebase UID.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching document ID.

identifier.description: Email address or normalized mobile number.

pinHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of 4-digit app PIN.

cnicHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of normalized 13-digit CNIC.

cnicLast4.description: Last 4 digits of CNIC for Admin display.

mobileHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of normalized mobile number.

kycDuplicateOf.description: Original UID if flagged as duplicate CNIC.

totalKhataAmount.description: Cached workshop total bill amount for Admin summary.

totalPendingAmount.description: Cached total pending balance for Admin summary.

customerCount.description: Cached customer count for Admin summary.

lastSyncAt.description: Epoch ms of last cloud sync.

lastBackupAt.description: Epoch ms of last cloud backup snapshot.

UserVaultDoc.title: UserVaultDoc
UserVaultDoc.description: Segmented workshop data shard under users/{userId}/vault/{docId} (core, ledger, operations, kyc) to stay well under Firestore 1MB doc limit.

docType.description: Shard type: core, ledger, operations, or kyc.

payloadJson.description: Serialized JSON payload for the shard.

UserBackupSnapshot.title: UserBackupSnapshot
UserBackupSnapshot.description: Daily automatic or manual full cloud backup snapshot under users/{userId}/backups/{backupId}.

payloadJson.description: Serialized JSON snapshot of workshop data.

createdAt.description: Epoch ms when snapshot was recorded.

CnicClaim.title: CnicClaim
CnicClaim.description: Global SHA-256 hashed 13-digit CNIC uniqueness lock ensuring strictly 1 CNIC = 1 Account without storing raw CNIC PII in shared lookup.

cnicHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of normalized 13-digit CNIC without dashes.

createdAt.description: Epoch ms when CNIC was registered.

MobileClaim.title: MobileClaim
MobileClaim.description: Global SHA-256 hashed normalized mobile uniqueness lock ensuring strictly 1 Mobile = 1 Account.

mobileHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of normalized mobile digits.

createdAt.description: Epoch ms when mobile was registered.

structure.description: Owner profile and security metadata scoped to userId == request.auth.uid or Admin.
Domain-sharded workshop data (core, ledger, operations, kyc) scoped to userId == request.auth.uid or Admin read.
Auto daily and manual cloud backup snapshots scoped to userId == request.auth.uid or Admin read.
Single-account CNIC hash claim enforcing 1 CNIC = 1 Account.
Single-account mobile hash claim enforcing 1 Mobile = 1 Account.
